Package index

Health expectancies (Sullivan method)

Calculation of life expectancies with and without disability from mortality rates and prevalences of disability by age.

CompleteDFLEtable()
Complete a dataframe with useful variables for the calculation of disability-free life expectancies (DFLE)

Prevalences by single year of age

Smoothing of prevalences observed by age bracket into prevalences by single year of age.

ApproxPrevalenceTable()
Transforms a table with prevalences by age brackets into a table with (smoothed) prevalences by age
prevalenceApprox()
Estimates prevalences by age from values by age brackets
prevalence_to_polynomial()
Estimates a polynomial approximation for prevalences by age

Projection of prevalences

Projection of prevalences and health expectancies, under hypotheses on life expectancies (prevalenceForecast()) or with models estimated on past observations (fitPrevalenceModel()).

prevalenceForecast()
Forecasts prevalences of disability and DFLEs
fitPrevalenceModel()
Estimates a model of the evolution of prevalences of disability by age
predict(<prevalence_model>)
Projects prevalences of disability with an estimated model
coef(<prevalence_model>) fitted(<prevalence_model>) residuals(<prevalence_model>) as.data.frame(<prevalence_model>) print(<prevalence_model>) summary(<prevalence_model>) print(<summary.prevalence_model>)
Results of the estimation of a model of prevalences
projectPrevalence()
Projects prevalences of disability and calculates life expectancies

Interactive example

runExample()
Runs examples of uses of the package

Datasets

Datasets provide examples for calculations. Apart from the example of the Sullivan manual, they concern France: most are data provided by Insee (the French national statistical institute) or DREES (the statistical unit of the French Ministry for Health and Social affairs).

Sullivan manual

sullivan
An example of calculation using Sullivan's method.
description_sullivan
A description of the variables in the dataset from Sullivan manual's calculation example.

Prevalences

FRAPAprevalence
Prevalence of the APA by age bracket, France, 2010-2024
FRDreesAPA
A dataset with share of APA beneficiaries in France
FRDreesAPA2017
A dataset with share of APA beneficiaries in France (December 2017)
FRDreesVQSsurvey2014
A dataset with disability prevalences in France (2014)
FRDreesVQSsurvey2021
A dataset with disability prevalences in France (2021)
FRGaliEUSilc
A dataset with prevalence of general activity limitations (GALI) in France
FRDreesEHPA
A dataset with proportions on people living in institutions in France according to Drees's EHPA survey

Population

FRInseePopulation
A dataset with population by sex and age, from Insee's 'bilan démographique' (annual population estimates)
FRInseePopulationForecast2016
A dataset with population by sex and age, from Insee's 2016 population forecast (central scenario)
FRInseePopulationForecast2021
A dataset with population by sex and age, from Insee's 2021 population forecast (central scenario)
FRInseePopulationForecast2026
A dataset with population by sex and age, from Insee's 2026 population forecast (central scenario)

Mortality

FRInseeMortalityrates
A dataset with observed mortality rates by sex and age, from Insee
FRInseeMortalityrates_t69
An (alternative) dataset with observed mortality rates by sex and age, from Insee
FRInseeMortalityForecast2016
A dataset with mortality rates from Insee's 2016 population forecast (central scenario)
FRInseeMortalityForecast2021
A dataset with mortality rates from Insee's 2021 population forecast (central scenario)
FRInseeMortalityForecast2026
A dataset with mortality rates from Insee's 2026 population forecast (central scenario)
